title: TypR Registry package entry
description: One packages/<name>.json file: the set of known Type Definitions for a single R package. Mirrors typR/registry.md §8.1 and the manifest fields typr's own `crates/typr-cli/src/type_definition.rs` (DefinitionManifest) and `type_registry.rs` (RepoSpec, Lockfile) actually parse — a definitions[] entry here is what a `typr types add github:<repository>` resolves against.

name.description: The R package name this file indexes definitions for, e.g. "shiny". Must match the filename: packages/shiny.json.

repository.description: GitHub "owner/repo" of the Definition Repository, optionally followed by a subdirectory path — no scheme, no host. Prefixed with "github:" this is exactly what typr's RepoSpec::parse (type_registry.rs) accepts; github: is the only hosting scheme understood (registry.md §7.3/§8.2). The subdirectory form (e.g. "we-data-ch/registry/definitions/dplyr") is how a monorepo long-tail entry (§8.2) points at its own typr-def.toml instead of the repository root.

version.description: semver of the Type Definition itself (typr-def.toml [definition].version), independent of the R package's own version.

rev.description: Commit SHA pinned at index time — never a branch or tag name. Reproducibility is by digest/rev, not by a mutable ref (registry.md D4, §7.2).

since.description: Minimum R package version this definition targets (typr-def.toml [package].since) — a floor, never a closed range (registry.md §7.2).

until.description: Only set when a breaking change is KNOWN, never speculative (typr-def.toml [package].until, optional).

source.description: Provenance (typr-def.toml [provider].type). `official` must be provable per registry.md §10 — hosted in the R package's own repository, or an org with a verification file in it — never taken on faith from this field alone.

tier.description: Default confidence tier for entries with no `#! tier:` of their own (typr-def.toml [definition].tier). T1 verified, T2 declared, T3 generated — registry.md §5.4.

capabilities.description: Mirrors typr-def.toml [capabilities]. Must match the repository's real content — `typr types add` rejects a fetch where undeclared R is found (registry.md §5.5).

r_shims.description: Ships executable R (an R/ shim directory).

extern_raw.description: Uses an `extern: (...) -> T r#"...R..."#` verbatim block anywhere.
